explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/787: the upper bound g(n) ≪ exp(√log n) due to Ruzsa [Ru05]. The Lean statement: ∃ C > 0, for all large n, g ℝ n ≤ exp(C·√(log n)), i.e. g(n) ≤ exp(O(√log n)). The docstring notes that this is the form actually proved in Ruzsa's paper; it is implied by the page's literal ≪ exp(√log n) and is the standard way the result is quoted. I did not open [Ru05] itself; the Lean form is the weaker of the two readings, so it is safe. Faithful.
